title: Mycoscape
description: A vanilla+ mod adding fungal biomes
body:
# Mycoscape

A vanilla+ modfocused entirely on environmental worldgen, a fungal forest biome, a new cave biome, and a full decorative block palette built around mushrooms and rotwood.

## Features

**Fungal Forest biome**: a rare Overworld biome with a dark color palette, fungal ambience, and soul sand valley atmosphere.

**Necrotic Caverns**: an eerie cave biome rich in resources with ambient mycelial veins.

**Rotwood wood set**: a wood set in a corrupted dark wood style found in the Fungal Forest.

**Mushroom blocks**: four species with grow stages (Blewit, Morel, Jack O'Lantern, Necroshroom) and giant mushroom cap blocks for each species.

**Custom Mushrooms**: Found in the Fungal Forest or the Necrotic Caverns. Necroshrooms are grown by placing other mushrooms on rotwood.

**Terrain blocks**: Overgrown Grass, Mycoslate, Necroshroom Hyphae, Jack O'Lantern Vein.

**Mushroom food items**: Blewit, Morel, Jack O'Lantern Mushroom, and Necroshroom are all edible with custom status effects

**Bonus Features**:
- Overgrown Grass: a cheap, six-sided grass for builders.
- Death Vine: a special and extra deadly cobweb variant.
- Mycelium Fabric: an efficient and easy way to farm wool.

Thanks for playing! We'd love to hear your feedback!
